scenario_templates.title: Navigate to Car Tires via Services Menu
scenario_templates.description: Verify that a user can open the Walmart home page, open the Services menu, and navigate to the 'Buy Tires & Schedule Installation' car tires browse page.

scenario_templates.title: Add Car Tires from Browse Page and View Cart Total
scenario_templates.description: Verify that a user can add car tires from the browse page and open the cart to view the updated total.

scenario_templates.title: Remove Tire from Cart and Proceed to Checkout (Unauthenticated User)
scenario_templates.description: Verify that a user can remove a tire from the cart and that clicking 'Continue to checkout' redirects to the login page when they are not signed in.

scenario_templates.title: Run WCAG Accessibility Scans on Key Pages
scenario_templates.description: Verify that WCAG accessibility scans can be run on the main user journey pages without critical issues.

scenario_templates.title: Search for Products
scenario_templates.description: Verify that a user can search for products and view search results.

scenario_templates.title: User Login
scenario_templates.description: Verify that a user can successfully log in with valid credentials.
